title: Feed Display Settings Glitch
summary: Identified a problem while using the web app. When looking at a feed that is generated through items sent to my Newsblur email address I get some odd windowing when I place the feed in list view. Attached are two screenshots to illustrate the issue. Notice in the screenshot that contains an opened feed article that the headline for the next feed item is in the bottom right corner.

Identified a problem while using the web app. When looking at a feed that is generated through items sent to my Newsblur email address I get some odd windowing when I place the feed in list view. Attached are two screenshots to illustrate the issue. Notice in the screenshot that contains an opened feed article that the headline for the next feed item is in the bottom right corner.
